statement: The pinned WiiBrew Player LEDs section describes output report 0x11 as the four-player-LED control report. Its first payload byte uses bits 4, 5, 6 and 7 to control LEDs 1, 2, 3 and 4 respectively; these bits can select combinations rather than only a one-hot player number. The same LED states are represented by bits 4–7 in input status report 0x20. This describes community protocol documentation, not measured LED-class permissions or physical brightness.
